title: Forward-Looking Commitment Smoothing and Monthly True-up Mechanism
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Summary: Implement a forward-looking commitment smoothing feature that allocates provisional usage credits ("soft credits") across customers' billing periods based on short-term usage forecasts, combined with a monthly true-up invoice that reconciles provisional allocations against actual consumption. Goal: reduce surprise overage incidents, smooth invoices for customers with bursty workloads, and provide predictable revenue recognition for Redwood.

Background: Customers frequently have bursty per-route traffic (training jobs, batch embed bursts, seasonal traffic). Current model causes sharp overage spikes and high support load. This PRD proposes an opt-in feature for customers on committed plans or tiered subscriptions where we: (1) predict next-period usage using 30-day sliding models, (2) pre-allocate soft credits that can be drawn first before hard overage is charged, (3) produce a single monthly true-up reconciliation line on invoices that shows provisional allocation, actual usage, and final charge/credit.

Key behaviors to implement: 1) Forecast window: 30 days lookahead using moving-average + seasonality adjustment for each customer-route pair. 2) Soft credit allocation: provisional credits applied to next invoice as non-binding allocations; visible in Console. 3) Consumption order: soft credits consumed first, then committed quota, then overage. 4) True-up: at invoice close, compute diff = actual - (committed + soft), if positive charge overage; if negative issue credit or rollover per plan rules. 5) Notification: email + console alerts at thresholds (70%, 90%, 110% of provisional allocation). 6) Opt-in and opt-out controls per account in Console and API.

Scope: MVP covers hosted plans and Dedicated; Private deployments require separate on-prem billing integration (out of scope for MVP). Implementation spans billing engine changes, console UI, usage forecasting service, accounting ledger entries, and invoice template updates.
requirements: R1: Forecasting model must produce per-customer-per-route 30-day forecast with 95th percentile confidence band
R2: System must create provisional soft credit entries in the ledger that are tagged and visible in Console
R3: Consumption order logic updated for token attribution: soft credits -> committed quota -> overage
R4: Monthly true-up calculation must run within 24 hours of billing period close and produce an audit-friendly diff line
R5: Customers must be able to opt-in/opt-out in Console and via Admin API within the billing settings page
R6: Alerts: console + email triggers at 70% and 90% of provisional allocation; final notification when forecast breached by >10%
R7: Billing analytics dashboard must show predicted vs actual and forecast error over time
R8: All changes must be backwards-compatible for customers who do not opt-in
acceptance_criteria: AC1: End-to-end flow demonstrable in staging: forecast generated, soft credits created, consumption order respected, and true-up applied on simulated invoice close
AC2: For a sampled set of 50 customers with bursty signals, monthly invoice variance (abs(actual - provisional) / actual) reduces by >=25% vs baseline
AC3: Notification delivery latency <5 minutes after threshold evaluation for 99% of cases
AC4: True-up job completes within 24 hours of billing period close for 99% of tenants
AC5: Console shows provisional credits, forecast error bands, and a clear audit trail link to ledger entries
AC6: API allows toggling opt-in and returns current provisional credit balance and forecast metadata
AC7: Finance acceptance: reconciling monthly invoices with soft credits produces correct GL entries and sample accounting for 20 invoices passes finance review
billing_logic: Definitions: committed_quota = plan commitment; provisional_soft = forecast allocation; usage = measured tokens/embeddings. Invoice calculation: provisional_charge = min(committed_quota + provisional_soft, usage) charged at plan rates. True-up delta = usage - (committed_quota + provisional_soft). If delta > 0 => overage charge at overage_rate. If delta < 0 => credit or rollover per plan (policy defaults to 30-day rollover, unless customer selects cash credit). Ledger entries: create provisional allocation entry (deferred), then at true-up convert deferred to actual charge/credit. Edge rounding: all token-unit math done at micro-token precision, invoice rounding at cents. Audit: include forecast score, model_version, and confidence interval in invoice metadata.
console_changes: Add Billing -> Forward Commitments panel showing: forecast chart (30-day), provisional soft credit value, percent consumed, opt-in toggle, historical forecast error. Add notification preference controls for thresholds and delivery channels. Include link to 'Explain forecast' modal with model_version and top contributing routes.
api_changes: Admin API endpoints: GET /v1/billing/forward-commitments -> returns provisional amount (string), forecast_horizon (string), model_id (string). POST /v1/billing/forward-commitments/opt-in -> accepts 'true'/'false'. GET /v1/billing/forward-commitments/audit/{period} -> returns ledger reference IDs as CSV string. All responses and payloads follow existing billing API auth scopes.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (pilot, 4 weeks): opt-in pilot for 30 selected customers (mix of bursty/steady) with manual finance review. Phase 2 (gradual rollout, 6 weeks): enable for committed-plan customers with automatic opt-in default off; instrument metrics. Phase 3 (full GA): open to all eligible plans and add API self-serve. Each phase gated by acceptance criteria and finance sign-off. Communication: customer webinar + knowledge base article + sample invoices and FAQ.
metrics: M1: Monthly invoice variance reduction (primary) - target >=25% for pilot cohort
M2: Number of surprise overage support tickets per 1000 active tenants - target -50% reduction
M3: Forecast accuracy (MAPE) at 30-day horizon - target <=20% for 80% of customers
M4: Opt-in rate among eligible customers after GA - target 15% within 3 months
M5: True-up job success rate within SLA (24h) - target 99%
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Forecast model underpredicts leading to frequent overage charges -> Mitigation: conservative forecast (use 75th percentile for provisional allocation) and clear num-notification thresholds
Risk: Finance system complexity with deferred entries -> Mitigation: work with Finance to design GL mapping and run parallel reconciliation for pilot
Risk: Confusing UX -> Mitigation: design research + microcopy + sample invoices and QA sessions during pilot
Risk: Abuse (customers gaming forecasts) -> Mitigation: include anti-abuse rules and anomaly flags; require manual review for large sudden allocation increases
